python3 - <<'PY'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')

p='src/codegen_support/runtime/data/fixed.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''    out.push_str(".globl _filter_break_lf\\n_filter_break_lf:\\n    .ascii \\"\\\\n\\"\\n");'''
new = '''    // php's default `line-break-chars` is CRLF, not a lone newline: measured on `php -n` 8.5.6,
    // `["line-length" => 8]` over "hello world" answers 18 bytes, `aGVsbG8g\\r\\nd29ybGQ=`.
    out.push_str(".globl _filter_break_crlf\\n_filter_break_crlf:\\n    .ascii \\"\\\\r\\\\n\\"\\n");'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)

p='src/codegen_support/runtime/io/stream_filter.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old = '''    crate::codegen_support::abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "x9", "_filter_break_lf");
    emitter.instruction("mov x10, #1");                                         // php's default is a lone newline'''
new = '''    crate::codegen_support::abi::emit_symbol_address(emitter, "x9", "_filter_break_crlf");
    emitter.instruction("mov x10, #2");                                         // php's default break is CRLF'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('default break is CRLF')
